BH function T1 verified against full-resolution crop. Right group11 carry is at row47, directly on BD.B10 output. Single right refs AP151, AP311 and R1823 print inline. All 13 lower-left AQ/BF/BG annotation fields restored from footer-left-notes-native.png.
